The plot illustrates the training rewards for two different policies, "Llama-On-Policy-Easy" and "Llama-LOFY-Easy," across an easy training set and a hard training set. For the easy training set, the x-axis is labeled "Steps" and ranges from 0 to approximately 400, showing a regular interval scale. The y-axis represents "Training Rewards," ranging from 0.0 to 0.4 in increments of 0.1, indicating the value range of rewards obtained. In the easy training set graph, the "Llama-On-Policy-Easy" is represented by a light blue line with marked squares, and "Llama-LOFY-Easy" by a red line without markers; both show similar trajectories with the rewards generally increasing over the steps.

In the hard training set, the x-axis is also labeled "Steps" with a range from 0 to around 500, again using a regular interval scale. The y-axis for "Training Rewards" has a different scale, ranging from 0.0 to 0.2 in increments of 0.1. Within this plot, the "Llama-On-Policy-Hard" line is depicted in light blue with square markers, while the "Llama-LOFY-Hard" line is in red without markers. These lines show more pronounced fluctuations compared to the easy training set, with rewards generally increasing over time but exhibiting more variability.
